Overview

Fort Wayne is a city in IN with a population of 267,490. Midwest affordability champion with three rivers, minor league baseball, and low taxes. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
